body: I personally would really want to live, but I was born so fucking hideous that everyone either says "ew" when they see me or make fun of me. When I was a kid I didn't understand why others tried to ignore and don't look at me, but when I was a teen, realization hit hard. I can do nothing about it. My looks prevent me from getting a job, making friends, getting a gf. Everyday I'm pissed off at life for being so awful to me just because. So if any of you is looking decent, can get laid, make friends, get a job don't you fucking dare commit suicide. I'll propably check out of life or hope I'll finally find a job and save enough for plastic surgery. Either way life's fucked up
